# Level preservation

Do not change existing level content unless the user explicitly requests level
changes. This includes layouts, brick attributes, item and enemy placements,
spawn schedules, objectives, timers, and dialogue.

Adding or changing game mechanics, items, graphics, or editor features does not
authorize adding those features to existing levels or rebalancing levels.
Keep new items available for custom levels without inserting them into the
built-in campaign unless specifically requested.
